AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
October 30, 2013
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Use Permit No. UP-2013-04 & Design Review No. DR-2013-19 Location: 680 E. Alosta Avenue
APN: 8612-001-057
Applicant: Delta Groups Engineering Inc. forVerizon Wireless.
A request for approval of a Use Permit and Design Review, to allow the construction and operation of a stealth, roof-mounted telecommunication facility located on an existing commercial building within the University District-Mixed Use (DU-MU) zone. This public hearing was continued from the September 25, 2013 public hearing to October 30, 2013, Planning Commission meeting.

Tentative Tract Map No. TTM 72405 & Design Review No. DR-2013-21 Location: 336-338 N. Azusa Avenue
Applicant: Chris Loh for CL Design/Builders Inc.
Tentative Tract Map and Design Review to allow the subdivision of two vacant parcels for condominium purposes and to construct a total of six (6) townhome units located within the City's CAZ (Azusa Avenue Corridor) zone.
